newsitem.title: UK: BTR climbs on renewed buying interest.
newsitem.headline: BTR climbs on renewed buying interest.

text.p: Shares in industrial conglomerate BTR Plc rose on Tuesday amid a return of buying interest, traders said.
The stock was up 5p at 255p by 1032 GMT, in trade of 2.4 million shares.

"The shares have fallen a long way and are now rising against the trend in the market," said one trader. "Probably because we've seen the end of a big sell order and a return of some buying interest."
The shares have fallen 22 percent over the last twelve months and almost nine percent in the last three weeks.
"The shares are clearly oversold," said a senior trader. "They should be trading around the 3.00 stg level."
